image_description: A white spoonbill wading in shallow, rippled water. The bird is captured in profile facing right, displaying its characteristic long, black, spatulate bill and predominantly white plumage. Its legs are dark and partially submerged, creating reflections in the water. The background consists of out-of-focus greyish water.
